description: FREE pre-check (100/day per wallet; pass caller): validation + F1-F9 assessability + pricing census + the exact step/block/fee quote for the run. No settlement resolution, no report.

caller.description: Solana base58 wallet of the operator; keys the free allowance (100/day per wallet).

run_id.description: The run key (no ':' characters - the memo form is colon-delimited).

settlements.description: Settlement records claimed as anchors: tx_signature, chain, run_id, task_key, memo_form, memo_expected, payer/payee wallets, amount_units.

steps.description: The run's step records (tool steps may carry settlement_ref; model steps are unpriced by the chain).

task_key.description: The task key the settlements are bound to.

name: subset_reconcile_precheck
